messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — while updating the TOC I ran the link checker and hit a couple of 404s plus some pages missing 'owner' frontmatter. Specifically saw /kb/cache-behavior -> 404 and a few guide pages without owner tags so they don't show in the new search facets. Can someone pick up quick fixes?

leo: I can take the redirects. @maria can you paste the list of broken paths? :+1:

maria: Sure, short list I found while crawling: 
```
/kb/cache-behavior -> /concepts/caching
/kb/old-quant -> /models/quantization
/guides/infra/redeploy -> /guides/infra/deployments
```
Also three guide pages missing owner: `/guides/infra/monitoring`, `/guides/infra/secrets`, `/guides/model/finetune-notes`.

sam: I can add the frontmatter owners for the infra pages. Which owner string should I use? eng-platform or docs?

maria: Use `owner: eng-platform` for infra pages, `owner: eng-ml` for the model page. Small note: please add `aliases:` frontmatter for any moved paths so old links still resolve.

leo: Started a tiny change for _redirects, local snippet I'm testing: 
```
/_kb/cache-behavior /concepts/caching 301
/_kb/old-quant /models/quantization 301
/guides/infra/redeploy /guides/infra/deployments 301
```
I'll open a PR and run the linkinator locally first.

maria: Nice. Recommended local checklist: `npm run docs:dev`, then `npx linkinator http://localhost:3000 --recurse` and fix any 4xxs. Also run `scripts/update-search-index --staging` after deploy.

leo: Opening PR now -> #842. Title: "docs: redirects + frontmatter fixes". Draft branch: docs/fix-redirects-frontmatter.

dev-docs-bot: New PR opened: #842 docs: redirects + frontmatter fixes by @leo — CI passed :white_check_mark:

maria: :eyes: assigning @sam to add the owner frontmatter, @leo please add a short CHANGELOG entry under docs/CHANGELOG.md (one line). Can we aim to land by EOD?

sam: Yep, will push a PR for the owner/frontmatter changes in ~2 hrs and request review from @maria.

deploy-bot: Docs build deployed to staging: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai — smoke tests OK, link-check passed.

maria: Verified staging search shows the model page now and the redirects are working. Thanks everyone — will merge once both PRs are green and then promote to prod. Closing thread after merge. :raised_hands:
